text:
zoe: quick heads-up  i'm about to take the EU preflight SLO snapshot for the 06:00 UTC change window. who should I include and any special checks?
ash: include p95/p50 per-route, p99 for embed and streaming, 5xx rate, error-budget burn %, kv-cache miss rate, and sequence-length heatmap. also gpu queue depth and kernel-fallback counter.
sam: add reranker 4xx->5xx conversion and model-variant fallback counts. last night reranker had a tiny burst.
sre-bot: SIM_ALERT: embed-route p95 +33% vs baseline in last 30m (baseline ~118ms -> ~157ms). sample trace id trace-eu-zz01.
zoe: did staging receive any runtime changes?
ash: quantize-v2.1.4-rc3 deployed to staging ~03:25 UTC. no prod changes.
sam: i'm pulling trace-eu-zz01 now for kernel-fallback logs and kv latency. query: trace.id=trace-eu-zz01
ash: logs show multiple kernel-fallback events on gpu-node-33, CPU wait spikes and stretched KV fetch latencies. a few isolated 502s in the tail.
zoe: proposal: hold the EU traffic shift for the window and pin the eu-embed route to v2.1.4-rc2 (previous stable) until we run kernel regression on rc3 overnight.
sre-bot: recorded pin: actor=@zoe route=eu-embed pinned_version=v2.1.4-rc2 reason="staging p95 spike correlated with kernel-fallbacks on rc3" ticket=RED-4219.
ash: agree. let's also include the unpin and emergency rollback commands in the release notes. e.g. `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2` and `deploy-bot rollback --route eu-embed --to-version v2.1.4-rc2 --force`.
sam: ran a quick smoke on the pinned version (2k samples): p95=119ms, 5xx=0.06%, kv-miss=2.1% -> smoke looks fine.
zoe: action items: 1) update release notes + changelog with hold + pin, 2) run kernel regression/perf matrix on rc3 overnight (sam), 3) re-eval at 04:30 UTC and post final snapshot; go/no-go at 05:00 UTC.
nash: abort criteria proposal: p95 > 1.25x baseline OR 5xx rate > 0.5% OR kernel-fallback-rate > 2x baseline. ramp plan if green: 10% -> 30% -> 100%.
sre-bot: saved ramp_plan to RED-4219 and annotated abort_criteria. will post snapshot at 04:30 UTC. tagging oncall: @sam @ash please ack hold and monitor overnight runs.
sam: ack. i'll run regressions and post results to RED-4219.
nash: i'll update the release notes PR with the hold note, pin info, and the quick unpin commands for ops.
zoe: thanks all. final note in release_notes draft: "2024-03-22 EU change window: traffic shift held; eu-embed pinned to v2.1.4-rc2 pending kernel-regression validation for rc3 (see RED-4219)."
sre-bot: reminder: include the trace id trace-eu-zz01 and sample traces in the ticket for postmortem if needed.
nash: good call. added trace links and runbook snippet to RED-4219.
zoe: final: no traffic shift until re-eval at 05:00 UTC. if green follow controlled ramp. i'll close this thread and update after the 04:30 snapshot.
sam: closing loop here, will ping when tests finish. :thumbsup:
(END)
